t: This is the Hayward Gallery, an art gallery within the Southbank Centre, on the South Bank of the River Thames. It sits beside the other Southbank Centre buildings, the National Theatre and BFI Southbank. It was designed by Ron Herron, an English architect and teacher best known for his work with the experimental group Archigram, and for their Walking City project. The name comes from Sir Isaac Hayward, who led the London County Council from 1947 until it was abolished in 1965, longer than anyone else.
